svg.title: Suminagashi: four weeks of contributions as floating ink
svg.desc: Each day from 06 October to 02 November 2026 falls into a bath of water as a drop of ink, wider for a busier day: 617 contributions on 28 days.
svg.text: A drop for every day of the last four weeks; a busier day, a wider ring.
OCT 06 – NOV 02 · 617 CONTRIBUTIONS ON 28 OF 28 DAYS · BUSIEST OCT 19 (114), IN VERMILION
